question: Does subtracting the same-state no-op teacher baseline remove privileged directional bias before SDPO distillation?

teacher.no_op_baseline: same teacher, same state/outcome, directional vector replaced by hold/zero

directional_feedback: measured target displacement vector and dominant axis/sign; no expert action label
baseline_invariant: only target_dx_m, target_dy_m, target_direction change; outcome fields remain identical
primary_diagnostic: privileged teacher, no-op teacher, residual norm, corrected target distribution, action coverage, and no-feedback deployment
limitations: five-action support instead of full language vocabulary
residual baseline tests directional bias; it does not prove long-horizon credit assignment
